title: Completion comparison for the two coefficient-model presentations
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative ring, I an ideal, and P any unbounded cochain complex of A-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Form sfbCompletedModel X I P and IsSfbAdicComplete using [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. On the equivalent coefficient-sized small pro-etale site form the completed coefficient ring, its exponent-one projection, and the termwise scalar-extended constant complex AdicPerfectModel.model of [lem-sfb-adic-perfect-model-complete-reduction]. Then sfbCompletedModel X I P is IsSfbAdicComplete if and only if the localization of AdicPerfectModel.model is locally derived complete for the kernel of that projection [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]. No boundedness, finite generation, projectivity, Noetherianity, maximality, or algebraic completeness assumption is made.

source.place: Proposition 6.6.11 reverse implication, completed coefficient model calculation; equivalent-site sheafification and scalar-extension presentation of the same model

proof.text: Use the canonical small-site completion ring isomorphism and its projection square. The sectionwise inverse ring isomorphisms show that extension of the actual projection kernel equals the normalized kernel. Use the cochain complex comparison and localize it. The exact small-site equivalence transports Q.objObjPreimageIso, and mapDerivedCategoryFactors identifies its image with the localization of the transported actual complex. Use the resulting derived isomorphism to replace the transported actual model by restriction of the normalized model. Local completeness is invariant under the derived isomorphism and is preserved and reflected by exact restriction of scalars along this ring isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Original three-step coefficient-model argument: ring/projection, kernel and completeness transport are proved; the cochain complex comparison is isolated.

Six hits, including SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence and its unit/counit formulas. This constructs the underlying module equivalence but does not identify these coefficient complexes or transport the local derived completeness tests.

theorem sfbPerfectModel_completion_transport (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ) :
    IsSfbAdicComplete X I (sfbCompletedModel X I P) ↔
      ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
        (ConstantCompletion.projection (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, 0} X) A I 0)
        ((ConstantCompletion.Q _).obj
          (AdicPerfectModel.model (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, 0} X) I P))
